answer: For a poll on a prism and nebula mural beside a juniper, the server sends each claimed roster member a ballot-specific confirmation link at their previously enrolled email address. It counts a ballot only if the link is activated and no ballot for that member has counted; otherwise it rejects it. Extra votes require more confirmations, potentially costing persuasion effort. Compromised email can enable impersonation, and inaccessible inboxes exclude voters.
